title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager
dek: About 60% of Bellwether's signups never fund their first account. You'd own every email and in-app message between signup and that first deposit.
description: Bellwether Finance offers a savings and investing account aimed at people who've never used one before. Our biggest, most stubborn drop-off point is between account creation and first deposit — the moment where someone has to actually link a bank account and move real money, and a lot of people just... don't, and we don't fully know why yet for each individual case.

You'd own the full lifecycle messaging program for that gap: email sequences, in-app prompts, and the experiment backlog testing different explanations, incentives, and timing. This is a highly measured role — you'll be expected to run A/B tests, read the results honestly (including when they're flat or negative), and adjust rather than just shipping more messages.

You'd work with one lifecycle designer, a data analyst who can pull funnel numbers on request, and regularly present findings to a product team that has opinions about what the drop-off means. Part of the job is making the case for what the data actually shows versus what's assumed.
requirements: 3+ years in lifecycle or growth marketing, ideally with fintech or another trust-sensitive product
Comfortable owning A/B tests end to end — hypothesis, setup, analysis, and a clear writeup of what happened
Experience with an ESP/marketing automation tool (we use Braze) and enough SQL to pull your own basic funnel data
Direct, honest communication — this role reports results to product weekly and the numbers aren't always flattering
Fintech, compliance-adjacent marketing experience is a plus given regulatory review on certain messaging
